b8d770bbd1e2.old_english: Ex vivo slice electrophysiology in an existing Wwox neuron-deleted line; tool compounds only; no brain-exposure statement is carried here and none is implied for any clinically used member.
b8d770bbd1e2.added_english: [IT41] Decision: whether any HCN-directed tool arm is run. Possible in silico: an ortholog and isoform census of the tools. New measure: sag and rebound at matched potential and deflection, with capacitance and access resistance by genotype. Reopen if: the excess sag persists at matched conditions. Priority: after the matched recording and after INV-05's minimum experiment; no HCN compound is nominated before it.

d6d17948e344.old_english: The slice preparation exists; the change is a reported bath and one added arm.
d6d17948e344.added_english: [IT41] Decision: whether a GluN2B-directed comparison is the better question (needs the d-APV abolition threshold x and one modulator's removable fraction, read at the burst). Possible in silico or from public sources: a primary source for the site and maximum effect of a second modulator; qualification of the AMPA tools. New measure: isolated NMDA-receptor current, x, removable fraction, measured bath magnesium and pH. Reopen if: a second modulator is shown to have a different ceiling at the same site, or the AMPA-tool qualification is delivered. Priority: first among the compound-facing investigations, because it is the cheapest measurement that decides whether the other arms are asked.
